Diseases due to air pollution in
Delhi-NCR
†*241. SHRI VISHAMBHAR
PRASAD NISHAD: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT, FOREST AND
CLIMATE CHANGE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that despite taking
various proactive measures to check air
pollution in Delhi and adjoining areas, the
desired result is not being achieved and
this has led to various health problems of
public at large;
(b) season-wise details of the increasing
pollution in Delhi during the last three
years and the steps being taken to improve
the air quality at present, and the outcome
thereof; and
(c) whether it is a fact that due to
excessive pollution, pollution borne
diseases are on the rise?
Rafale aircraft deal
*242. SHRI SANJAY SINGH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has entered
into an Inter-Governmental Agreement with
France for the purchase of 36 Rafale jets in
fly-away condition to be manufactured by
Dassault Aviation with an offset requirement
of manufacturing 50 per cent of equipment
in partnership with an Indian
company;
(b) whether Dassault Aviation
incorporated a Joint Venture to fulfil its
offset requirement with Reliance Defence,
a company having no prior experience in
manufacturing equipments for jets;
and
(c) if so, what are Government's
comments on the involvement of an
inexperienced company in the manufacture
of such a sensitive defence equipment?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

84
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Army personnel disabled during
training
†*243. CH. SUKHRAM SINGH
YADA V: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of soldiers and trainee
officers who have been handicapped while
undergoing military training during the last
three years;
(b) whether the Ministry is considering
to change the methods of training in view
of the continued increase in disability cases
during training so that disability of trainee
officers is minimised;
(c) whether the services of trainee
officers/soldiers, disabled during the
training, are terminated and if so, number
of such cases during the last three years;
and
(d) details of the facilities provided to
such officers/soldiers?
Committee for review of capital
acquisition projects
*244. SHRI HARIV ANSH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any
proposal to constitute a Committee to
review the ongoing capital acquisition
projects and suggest ways of taking them
fruitful towards results; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Identification of eligible BPL families
†*245. SHRI RANJIB BISWAL: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
display information regarding the State-
wise list of people living Below Poverty
Line (BPL) on the Internet, so that only
the genuinely poor persons can be identified
and can avail the benefits of Government
sponsored schemes and ineligible people
illegally availing of the benefits meant for
poor persons can be identified;
(b) if so,  details thereof and  action
taken in this regard;
(c) if not, how does Government
proposes to identify the ineligible people
who are living above the poverty line and
misusing the benefits of Government
facilities meant for BPL people; and
(d) the reaction of Government thereto?
Fund utilisation for MGNREGA and
PMAY
*246. SHRI T. RATHINAVEL: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the provisions
made for administrative costs under certain
schemes including Pradhan Mantri Awas
Yojana (PMAY) are not being fully utilised;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the total
admissible administrative expenditure for
MGNREGA was ` 3411 crore, of which
` 520 crore remained unspent; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?

85
Study on air pollution in India
*247. SHRIMATI VANDANA
CHAV AN: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT, FOREST AND
CLIMATE CHANGE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has carried out
any scientific studies on air pollution and
to determine its effects on health during
the last  three years and if so, the details
thereof;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor and
details of the measures that are intended to
be taken; and
(c) reasons for the standards of the
Indian Pollution Index being less stringent
as compared to the level of permissible
pollutants index issued by the World Health
Organisation?
Blacklisting of firms for defence
procurement

the Minis

Vacancies of officers/soldiers in the
armed forces
†2561. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large
number of posts of officers in the Navy,
Air Force and the Army are lying vacant
presently and if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether, despite several efforts
made by the Forces for improvement of
their image, the shortage of officers and
soldiers is continuously increasing in the
forces and there was a shortage of 1.19 per
cent of officers in the last nine months and
of 15.38 per cent of officers as on July,
2017; and
(c) if so, the steps being taken to fill the
vacant posts expeditiously in all three
wings of the forces?
Transfer of technology in Rafale jet deal
2562. SHRI SANJAY SINGH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Inter-
Governmental Agreement with France for
the purchase of 36 Rafale jets does not
include a Transfer of Technology (ToT)
agreement;
(b) if so, reasons for the absence of an
agreement on ToT;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
previous deal under the earlier Government
in 2012 included a ToT agreement; and
(d) if so, details of the rationale behind
scrapping the previous understanding on
ToT?
Ceasefire violations on LoC
2563. SHRI KIRANMAY NANDA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that ceasefire
violations on Pakistan border and Line of
Control (LoC) have become a common
phenomenon;
(b) whether Government is proposing
some steps to control Ceasefire violations;

(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Status of cadre review of Barrack and
Stores cadre of MES
2564. SHRIMATI KAHKASHAN
PERWEEN: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the first cadre
review of Barrack and Stores cadre of
Military Engineer Services (MES) has been
approved by Government in December,
2017;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
approved cadre review has not yet been
implemented by the department;
(c) if so, the details thereof along with
reasons for delay in implementation and
probable date by which it will be
implemented; and
(d) the details of cadre review of all
other cadres of MES with change in cadre
strength in each stage?
Loss of lives/property due to firing on
border
2565. SHRIMATI RAJANI PATIL:
SHRI P. BHATTACHARY A:
SHRI DARSHAN SINGH
Y ADA V:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that firing by
Pakistani Army on Indian Army in Jammu
and Kashmir has resulted in loss of lives
and property in the State;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) details of action taken by the Army
and Government?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Setting up of a Defence University
2566. MAHANT SHAMBHU
PRASADJI TUNDIYA: Will the Minister
of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government plans to set
up a Defence University in the country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Connecting road from Darbuk to DBO
2567. SHRI MD. NADIMUL HAQUE:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
due to absence of a road route to reach
Daulat Beg Oldi (DBO), the troops
deployed there have to traverse a long
distance with huge loads; and
(b) the details of steps taken by
Government to build an all weather road
connecting Darbuk to DBO and by when
would it be ready?
Winding up of Army Postal Services
†2568.SHRI VISHAMBHAR
PRASAD NISHAD:
CH. SUKHRAM SINGH
YADA V:
SHRIMATI CHHAY A
VERMA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has decided to wind up the Army Postal
Service (APS);
(b) if so, the time line to dispense with
Army Postal Service;
(c) the manner in which the job of
sending very important documents to their

604
destinations would be executed after
closure of APS;
(d) where would the soldiers, who are
currently serving with APS, be deployed
after the closure of the department; and
(e) whether it is also a fact that
Government is continuing with new
recruitment in APS?
Creation of posts in MES

to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Engineer-in-
Chief is the head of the organisation of
Military Engineering Services (MES);
(b) whether three posts of ADG (Coast
Guard/Northern Command/Eastern
Command) have been created in MES
